transcription: My husband is a mama's boy but his mother made me her enemy, so I took everything. When I say my husband 32 Molly's a mama's boy, I don't mean he calls her every Sunday. I mean he can't breathe without her permission. He won't buy socks unless she says they're the right thickness. She chose our wedding venue. She made him cancel our honeymoon because what if something happened while you were gone? She's perfectly healthy, BTW. A 29 female tree to play the supportive wife. I knew they were close. But I didn't realize I married them both. She hated me from the jump. Smiled in public, backstabbed in private. Little digs about my weight. Comments about how women these days don't know how to keep a home. She even whispered at our wedding. It's not too late to walk away, sweetheart. But the real war started when we moved into our house. Correction the house's parents helped him buy read they paid the down payment so they could legally stay involved. She started letting herself in. Redecorating. Replacing groceries she didn't like. Setting up a camera for security in our kitchen. I told him we needed to set boundaries. He said I was overreacting. He even called me disrespectful when I unplugged her hidden camera. So I started digging. I found out the house. Wasn't in our name. It was in his and hers. I was basically living in my own mother and law's house. I confronted him. He said, she only did that to protect our investment. You're being paranoid. Then came the breaking point. I came home early.
